tasks.work: Parse scoped options and encode original operation, text, and button data.
Write an anonymous script file, rewind it, and exec osascript with top-level activation and native result handling.
Verify all five fresh source-bound CUA cases, original process/button expectations, raw hashes, and complete manual visual verdicts.

limitations: This parent-run smoke track does not claim full zenity reconstruction.

source_assisted_fidelity_repair.original_boundary: CLI dialog data -> anonymous JavaScript file -> Unix exec -> osascript -> native dialogs
source_assisted_fidelity_repair.rust_boundary: Rust JSON data -> anonymous JavaScript file -> Unix exec -> osascript -> native dialogs

result_handling: The Unix exec delegates stdout and process status directly to osascript. Rust does not wait for a child or parse a JSON result.
